column3: The character from the FIRST image is H: keep him EXACTLY the same (bald, white letter H on the forehead, big muscular body, black shorts, olive tactical belt, black wrist wraps), same semi-realistic comic illustration style, NOT flat or 2D. The character from the SECOND image is KABIR: keep him exactly the same (lean wiry man, messy black hair, stubble, grey tank top, dark track pants). Horizontal 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, 1280x720, bold, simple, readable on a phone. Both men side by side facing the viewer on a plain dark navy background. Both arms are shown like a glowing X-ray: H (huge) has a giant arm but only a few dull grey muscle fibres glow faintly; KABIR (thin) has a skinny arm where ALL the fibres glow bright yellow-orange with electric sparks and a glowing nerve line. H looks confused, Kabir smirks. Top: big white extra-bold italic text "IT'S NOT MUSCLE". No other text.
